nom: Bubble Soft Launch Hydrating Cream Cleanser

avis.texte: This was the first bubble product that I have tried. I was immediately impressed at this soft launch hydrating cream cleanser from the beginning. It is great on my combination skin; dry and oily. It keeps the oily part of my face in control and hydrates the dry part of my neck without causing tightness. The packaging is cute and nice. It doesn't remove makeup the best, but it still removes most products (depending on how strong the mascara is). The packaging is really cute and lasts a while; probably four to six months, assuming you use one/two pumps. Overall, a great product to try.

I cannot understand how this is rated so highly. I wanted a cream cleanser for my somewhat dry skin, but this is not it. Other reviewers say it removes makeup, have no idea what they're talking about. It doesn't remove even the most minimal makeup. I always have to use micellar water or toner afterwards to get the remaining film off after rinsing. I should have returned it. The search continues...

Ran out of my normal cleanser and thought I'd give this a try. Its not moisturizing or drying. I do like the pump bottle but it doesnt give you much product so you use 4-5 pumps per wash. For the price I think something like Cera Ve is better. Skip this one.
Amazing, use it every day and my face feel 10x smoother and softer
